newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WESTPAC LAUNCHES NEW HOME LOAN INCENTIVES.
newsitem.headline: WESTPAC LAUNCHES NEW HOME LOAN INCENTIVES.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp on Thursday launched a series of initiatives to customers with its no-frills First Option mortgage.
The initiatives included a range of new features to First Option home loans and an improved home loan inquiry system, available from today.

First Option home loans were now at 6.19 percent and included access to available funds when required, an allowance for customers to draw their loans down, an option for customers to obtain additional finance and other new features.

"With its additional features, the First Option home loan fills a gap in the market where customers want both a low rate and access to flexible features," Peter Hanlon, Westpac head of personal marketing said in a statement.
"Customers benefit from a low 6.19 percent rate and the choice to use a range of features which are usually restricted to fully featured higher rate loans."
